_source: تقويم الهادي (Taqweem Al-Hadee), Manama, Kingdom of Bahrain. Supplied by the owner 2026-10-05 as the reliable Shia calendar for Bahrain. Printed in 12-hour form without AM/PM; converted to 24-hour here. Imsak and Sunset are not printed on that calendar - Imsak below is AlAdhan's Fajr-10 convention and Sunset is AlAdhan's, both marked so they are never mistaken for Al-Hadee's own values.
